name: query_stats
description: Execute a registered warehouse operation. Supply operation and its arguments. The server pins the release; optional season, phase and before_date select scope. last_season means the latest completed season. Errors are recoverable. Numbers, units, samples and equivalent-analysis links come from exact evidence.

description: Resolve a player name, typo or NBA ID. Returns close candidates; choose an ID and state the assumed identity instead of asking the user.

description: List catalog definitions, units and observed season/phase coverage. Optional key or category filters; paginate with offset. Coverage does not certify complete seasons.

description: Read an immutable contract book. Requires book_id, financial_season, known_at and effective_on. Independent of basketball scope. Unknown money stays unknown.
